name: backup_audit
description: Find guests with missing or stale backups, unscheduled guests and failed jobs.

arguments.name: max_age_hours
arguments.desc: Backups older than this are stale.

arguments.name: node
arguments.desc: Only audit guests on this node.

name: ceph_health
description: Analyse Ceph: health checks, OSD up/in counts, PG states, monitor quorum, capacity.

name: cluster_health
description: Check quorum, node availability, CPU/memory pressure, storage fill levels and HA.

name: compare_nodes
description: Compare live CPU, I/O wait, load, memory, swap and versions across nodes.

arguments.name: nodes
arguments.desc: Nodes to compare. Defaults to all online nodes.

name: get_guest
description: Show one guest's live status and full configuration (secrets redacted).

name: get_task_status
description: Return the state of a Proxmox task and the tail of its log.

arguments.name: upid
arguments.desc: Task id (UPID) as returned by write tools.

arguments.name: log_lines
arguments.desc: Number of log lines to return from the end of the task log (0-500).

name: list_guests
description: List VMs and containers across the cluster with resource usage, tags and HA state.

arguments.name: include_templates
arguments.desc: Also list VM and container templates.

name: list_nodes
description: List all cluster nodes with status, CPU and memory utilisation.

name: node_maintenance_status
description: Show pending Proxmox updates, needed reboots and expiring node certificates.

name: plan_node_evacuation
description: Plan how to empty a node for maintenance without breaking HA or overloading others.

arguments.name: exclude_targets
arguments.desc: Nodes that must not receive guests.

arguments.name: memory_limit
arguments.desc: Max memory use allowed on targets.

name: recent_task_failures
description: List tasks that failed recently, grouped by type. Good first stop after an incident.

arguments.name: hours
arguments.desc: Time window to look back, in hours (1-720).

arguments.name: limit
arguments.desc: Maximum number of failed tasks to return (1-500).

name: recommend_placement
description: Rank nodes for a new VM/container by memory headroom, CPU load and vCPU over-commit.

name: storage_health
description: Check ZFS pools and physical disks for anything that threatens data.
